sinov: Bo'sh holatda Yuborish → «Ism kiriting»; «Aziza» yozilganda → «Salom, Aziza!»; Yuborish → «Rahmat, Aziza!»; toggle ikki marta — yashiriladi va qaytadi.
rubrika:
Grade a beginner DOM events task out of 10. HTML and CSS are given (#about, #toggle, #name, #greet, #send, #msg); grade script.js by how the page behaves. The editor's AI agent may help.
1. (3) Clicking #toggle hides #about; clicking again shows it (any method: style.display, hidden, classList).
2. (3) Typing in #name updates #greet live on every input event: 'Привет, <name>!'.
3. (3) Clicking #send: empty name → 'Введите имя', otherwise 'Спасибо, <name>!' (if/else).
4. (1) The page does not reload and no errors appear in the console.
Accept onclick/oninput properties or addEventListener, innerText or textContent. Do not penalize trimming spaces or extra styling.
